insights.text: The Mascot Industrial Complex + Live Call-Ins is at 7,694 views, but no prior episode has real data this early — first comparable checkpoint comes as snapshots age.
Bumpy Takeoff flatlined at week 3; Data vs. Intuition, Web Designers Are Back + Call-Ins flatlined at week 3 (weekly gain <3% of total). Plan promo around a ~3-week active window (sample of 2).
X delivers 80% of first-week views; after week 2, YouTube carries 37% of new views (full-history sample of 3). X and YT views are different units — read as share, not equivalence.
On X, @designertom is the stronger distribution arm — 60% of all-episode X views (20,653 ridd vs 30,497 tom).
Mixed Media Workflows, Game Design, + Live Call-Ins: total 21,212 is >2x the all-episode median (8,174) — treat as promo-driven outlier, not topic signal.
YT engagement (likes+comments per 1k views): Bumpy Takeoff leads at 49.7, Mixed Media Workflows, Game Design, + Live Call-Ins trails at 30. Reach and resonance are separating.

Mixed Media Workflows, Game Design, + Live Call-Ins, Backyard Designers behind-the-scenes, Goodbye, Blank Canvas + Live Call-Ins were registered late — cumulative totals are correct, but early weekly history doesn't exist. They are excluded from velocity/decay baselines and marked "partial history."
